epics.title: Full Stack Orchestration
epics.jtbd: When receiving the delivered system, I want to be able to start the full stack with a single command, so that I can launch and verify the product end-to-end.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Time to first successful local launch and health-check response
epics.tocConstraintRef: Environment setup and local verification bottleneck
requirements: R1: The repository root must contain a docker-compose.yml that orchestrates the entire application stack.
R2: The orchestrated stack must expose a health-check endpoint to verify the system is running and ready.

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml with health check
slices.jtbd: When implementing the orchestration for this epic, I want to provide a docker-compose.yml that starts all services, so that the full stack can be launched and verified for real.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root
When a developer runs docker compose up
Then the full stack (backend, frontend, database) starts successfully
Given the running stack
When a request is made to the exposed health-check endpoint
Then it returns a success status indicating the system is ready
